blacklist.enabled.doc: Loads the blocklist file and refuses peers whose address it lists.

blacklist.file.doc: The blocklist file, in CIDR, P2P or DAT format; read again when a `blacklist` option changes.

blocking.default_scopes.doc: What a new block stops unless it says otherwise: any of `uploads`, `searches`, `browse`, `messages`, `rooms`, `downloads`, `distributed`.

chat.accept_private_room_invitations.doc: Takes invitations to other users' private rooms; when off the server is told we take none.

chat.highlight_words.doc: Words and phrases that make a room message count as mentioning us, matched in any case as whole words.

chat.max_message_length.doc: The longest message that may be sent, in characters.

chat.notifications.enabled.doc: The UI may show notifications, once the browser allows it.

chat.notifications.mentions.doc: Notifies of room messages that mention us.

chat.notifications.only_when_hidden.doc: No notification while the tab is visible with the message's chat open.

chat.notifications.room_messages.doc: Notifies of every message in rooms set to notify of all messages.

chat.notifications.sound.doc: Plays a short sound with each notification.

debug.doc: Debug mode: logs at debug level and names the module on every log line.

directories.downloads.doc: Where finished downloads are moved; `downloads` in the data directory when not set. A directory given here must exist and be writable.

directories.incomplete.doc: Where downloads in progress are written; `incomplete` in the data directory when not set. A directory given here must exist and be writable.

feature.swagger.doc: Serves the OpenAPI document at `/swagger/v0/swagger.json` and its browser at `/swagger`.

filters.search.request.doc: Regular expressions; an incoming search whose text matches one is not answered.

flags.config_watch_poll.doc: Watches the configuration files by reading them every few seconds, for mounts where file notifications do not arrive.

flags.experimental.doc: Turns on features still being tried out.

flags.force_migrations.doc: Applies every database migration whether or not it looks applied.

flags.force_share_scan.doc: Scans the shares in full at startup even when the share cache is current.

flags.legacy_windows_tcp_keepalive.doc: Uses the older socket keepalive control on Windows versions before 10 1709.

flags.log_sql.doc: Logs every SQL statement with its values; the log then holds usernames, filenames and messages.

flags.log_unobserved_exceptions.doc: Logs the failure of background work nothing waits for.

flags.no_config_watch.doc: Does not watch the configuration files; changes then need a reload signal or a restart.

flags.no_connect.doc: Does not connect to the Soulseek server at startup.

flags.no_share_scan.doc: Does not scan the shares at startup.

flags.no_start.doc: Sets everything up, then exits instead of serving; for checking a configuration.

flags.no_version_check.doc: Does not check for a newer release.

flags.optimistic_relay_file_info.doc: A relay controller trusts an agent's share listing for whether a file exists, instead of asking the agent first.

flags.volatile.doc: Keeps every database in memory: nothing is saved and nothing survives a restart.

headless.doc: Serves the API only, no web UI.

instance_name.doc: Names this instance in logs and to a relay controller.

integrations.scripts.doc: Scripts by name, each run when one of its events is raised.

logger.loki.doc: The base URL of a Grafana Loki instance to push logs to.

logger.no_color.doc: Writes the console log without colour; `NO_COLOR` set to anything does the same.

logging.level.doc: The least severe level logged: `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` or `trace`; `debug` mode lowers it to `debug`.

logging.targets.doc: Levels for single modules, such as `soulseek_client::distributed=trace`.

metrics.url.doc: The path the metrics are served at.

notifications.transfers.batch_finished.doc: Notifies when every download of a batch, such as an album, has finished.

notifications.transfers.download_finishe.doc: Notifies of each download that finished.

notifications.transfers.upload_queued.doc: Notifies when another user queues an upload from us.

paths.cache.doc: The cache directory, which holds what can be rebuilt, such as the share index.

paths.config.doc: The configuration directory, which holds the configuration files and the scripts directory; set by the environment or the command line only, since the files are in it.

paths.data.doc: The data directory, which holds the databases, runtime overrides and the instance lock.

paths.logs.doc: The directory of the daily log files.

relay.agents.doc: The agents allowed to connect to this controller, by name.

relay.controller.address.doc: The controller's base URL, such as `https://host:5031`.

relay.controller.api_key.doc: One of the controller's API keys, with the read-write or administrator role.

relay.controller.downloads.doc: Fetches finished downloads from the controller.

relay.controller.ignore_certificate_erro.doc: Accepts any TLS certificate from the controller.

relay.controller.secret.doc: The secret the controller has for this agent.

relay.mode.doc: `controller`, `agent`, or `debug` for a controller that is also its own agent.

remote_configuration.doc: Lets administrators change the configuration files and runtime overrides through the API.

remote_file_management.doc: Lets the files API delete files in the download and incomplete directories.

retention.events.doc: Logged events older than this are deleted; `0` keeps them.

retention.events_max_rows.doc: The most logged events kept; the oldest beyond it are deleted, `0` keeps them all.

retention.logs.doc: Daily log files older than this are deleted, at least two days.

retention.messages.max_per_conversation.doc: The most read private messages kept per conversation, at least 250.

retention.messages.max_per_room.doc: The most messages kept per room, at least 250.

retention.messages.mentions.doc: Room messages that mention us older than this are deleted.

retention.messages.private.doc: Read private messages older than this are deleted.

retention.messages.rooms.doc: Room messages older than this are deleted, except those that mention us; at least an hour.

retention.search.doc: Finished searches older than this are deleted, at least five minutes.

retention.transfers.download.errored.doc: Transfers that failed with an error, a timeout, a refusal or a size mismatch.

retention.transfers.download.failed.doc: Transfers that errored or were cancelled.

retention.transfers.purge_removed_after.doc: Transfers removed from the listings longer ago than this are deleted for good, at least five minutes; removed transfers are kept for the history when not set.

retention.transfers.upload.errored.doc: Transfers that failed with an error, a timeout, a refusal or a size mismatch.

retention.transfers.upload.failed.doc: Transfers that errored or were cancelled.

retention.users.doc: Users not seen for this long leave the users directory, unless pinned, noted, tagged, blocked or in a group.

rooms.doc: Chat rooms to join after logging in. Rooms taken off the list are not left.

shares.cache.retention.doc: How often the shares are scanned again on their own, at least an hour; never when not set.

shares.cache.storage_mode.doc: `memory`, rebuilt at every start, or `disk`, kept in the cache directory.

shares.cache.workers.doc: How many files are read at the same time during a scan.

shares.directories.doc: Shared directories, each an absolute path, optionally with `[alias]` before it and `!` in front to exclude it instead.

shares.filters.doc: Regular expressions; a file whose full path matches one is not shared.

shares.follow_symlinks.doc: Follows links to directories and files inside the shares; share roots are always opened through a link.

shutdown_timeout.doc: How long a shutdown waits for work in progress before the process exits anyway.

soulseek.browse.response_timeout.doc: How long a user has to start sending their share listing, at least a second; a large share takes a while to put together.

soulseek.connection.buffer.read.doc: The read buffer of a connection, at least 1024.

soulseek.connection.buffer.transfer.doc: The buffer of a transfer connection, at least 81920; a change applies to the transfers that start after it.

soulseek.connection.buffer.write.doc: The write buffer of a connection, at least 1024.

soulseek.connection.buffer.write_queue.doc: How many writes may wait per connection, from 5 to 5000.

soulseek.connection.mtu.doc: The MTU of the server connection, from 576 to 65535; the system's when not set.

soulseek.connection.timeout.connect.doc: How long a connection may take to open, at least a second.

soulseek.connection.timeout.inactivity.doc: How long a peer connection may be idle before it is closed, at least a second.

soulseek.connection.timeout.transfer.doc: How long a transfer may stall before it fails, at least 30 seconds.

soulseek.connection.timeout.transfer_res.doc: How long an upload, or a download asked for with a transfer request, waits for the peer to answer the request, at least a second.

soulseek.description.doc: The profile text other users see.

soulseek.diagnostic_level.doc: The least severe protocol diagnostic logged: `none`, `warning`, `info` or `debug`.

soulseek.distributed_network.disable_chi.doc: Refuses children in the distributed network.

soulseek.distributed_network.disabled.doc: Takes no part in the distributed search network.

soulseek.limits.distributed_parent_negot.doc: How long a would-be distributed parent has to send its branch level, root and a search.

soulseek.limits.max_cached_peer_connecti.doc: How many message connections to other users are kept open.

soulseek.limits.max_concurrent_peer_conn.doc: How many connections to other users are being opened at once.

soulseek.limits.max_concurrent_search_re.doc: How many searches from the distributed network are answered at once.

soulseek.limits.max_message_size.doc: The largest message accepted from another user; a large share's browse listing is the only message that is legitimately big.

soulseek.limits.search_response_cache_si.doc: How many search responses are kept for a searcher we could not reach yet.

soulseek.limits.user_endpoint_cache_size.doc: How many users' addresses are remembered between connections.

soulseek.listen_ip_address.doc: The address the peer listener binds.

soulseek.listen_port.doc: The port other users connect to us on.

soulseek.picture.doc: The profile picture other users see, a JPEG, GIF or BMP file.

soulseek.search.max_concurrent.doc: How many of our searches run at once, at least 1; the others wait their turn.

soulseek.server_keepalive.enabled.doc: Sends keep-alive probes on the server connection.

soulseek.server_keepalive.idle.doc: How long the connection is silent before the first probe, at least a second.

soulseek.server_keepalive.interval.doc: The time between probes, at least a second.

soulseek.server_keepalive.probes.doc: How many probes go unanswered before the connection is dropped, at least 1.

soulseek.username.doc: The account to log in as; without it reseek does not connect.

throttling.search.incoming.circuit_break.doc: How many incoming searches may wait before new ones are dropped.

throttling.search.incoming.concurrency.doc: How many incoming searches are answered at the same time.

throttling.search.incoming.response_file.doc: The most files one search response carries.

transfers.download.destination.exists.doc: What happens when the file already exists: `rename` or `overwrite`.

transfers.download.destination.permissio.doc: The mode in chmod's octal form, such as `644`; the system's default when not set. No effect on Windows.

transfers.download.destination.subdirect.doc: The relative directory under the downloads directory a file is moved to, with `${SOURCE_USERNAME}`, `${SOURCE_PATH}`, `${SOURCE_DIRECTORY}`, `${BATCH_ID}`, `${BATCH_EXTERNAL_ID}`, `${SEARCH_ID}` and `${SEARCH_TEXT}` filled in.

transfers.download.request_style.doc: How a file is asked for: `queue`, the queue request every current client sends, or `transfer_request`, the older transfer request the peer answers.

transfers.download.retry.attempts.doc: How many times a download is tried, the first try included; 1 never tries again.

transfers.download.retry.delay.doc: How long to wait before the first retry; each later wait doubles, at least a second.

transfers.download.retry.max_delay.doc: The longest wait between retries, at least 30 seconds.

transfers.download.retry.partial.doc: What a retry does with the part already downloaded: `resume` or `overwrite`.

transfers.download.slots.doc: How many downloads run at the same time; no limit when not set. A lower number lets the downloads that run finish and starts no new one until fewer run.

transfers.download.speed_limit.doc: The total download speed in KiB/s; no limit when not set.

transfers.groups.default.upload.priority.doc: The group's priority; a lower number is served first.

transfers.groups.default.upload.slots.doc: How many of the group's uploads run at once; no limit beyond the global one when not set.

transfers.groups.default.upload.speed_li.doc: The group's total upload speed in KiB/s; no limit when not set.

transfers.groups.default.upload.strategy.doc: The order the group's queue is served in: `roundrobin` or `firstinfirstout`.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.priorit.doc: The group's priority; a lower number is served first.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.slots.doc: How many of the group's uploads run at once; no limit beyond the global one when not set.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.speed_l.doc: The group's total upload speed in KiB/s; no limit when not set.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.strateg.doc: The order the group's queue is served in: `roundrobin` or `firstinfirstout`.

transfers.groups.user_defined.doc: Groups of the user's own, by name.

transfers.ui.queue_refresh.doc: How often the page asks for the queue place of visible remotely queued downloads, at least 30 seconds.

transfers.upload.slots.doc: How many uploads run at the same time over every group. A lower number lets the uploads that run finish and starts no new one until fewer run.

transfers.upload.speed_limit.doc: The total upload speed in KiB/s; no limit when not set.

web.authentication.api_key.doc: One API key given outside the files: the key alone, or `;`-separated parts of `role=<role>`, `cidr=<networks>` and the key, such as `role=readonly;cidr=192.168.1.0/24;<key>`. An administrator key from anywhere by default.

web.authentication.disabled.doc: Lets every request in without a credential, as an administrator; the same as trusting every network.

web.authentication.local.only_from.doc: The networks password login is allowed from; anywhere when empty.

web.authentication.password_hash.doc: The administrator account's password as an argon2id hash, used instead of `password` when set.

web.authentication.proxy.email_header.doc: The header with the user's email address.

web.authentication.proxy.enabled.doc: Takes the identity the proxy forwards.

web.authentication.proxy.groups_header.doc: The header with the user's groups, separated by `|` or `,`.

web.authentication.proxy.role_mapping.de.doc: The role of a user in none of the groups, or `deny` to refuse them.

web.authentication.proxy.role_mapping.re.doc: Groups whose users may only read.
Groups whose users may read and write.

web.authentication.proxy.session.doc: Starts a session when the web UI's page is served to a user the proxy names and the browser has no session yet, so the page's later requests work without the proxy's headers; API requests act on the headers alone. Off, the headers are read on every request.

web.authentication.session_idle.doc: How long a session lasts without being used.

web.authentication.session_ttl.doc: How long a session from a local login lasts.

web.authentication.trusted_networks.doc: Networks whose requests need no credential.

web.authentication.trusted_role.doc: The role of a request from a trusted network.

web.content_path.doc: Serves the UI from this directory, relative to the program's directory, instead of the one built into the program.

web.cors.allowed_origins.doc: Origins such as `http://localhost:5173` that may call the API with credentials; `*` lets any origin call it without credentials. None when empty.

web.external_url.doc: The public base URL, such as `https://reseek.example.net/reseek`, for login redirects; worked out from each request when not set.

web.files.archive_max_bytes.doc: The largest folder that may be downloaded as one zip.

web.files.serve.doc: Lets the browser open and download files from the download directories.

web.files.serve_speed_limit.doc: The speed files and folders are served to the browser at, in KiB/s, over every one sent at once; no limit when not set.

web.hostnames.doc: The host names the daemon is reached by; a trusted network is only trusted on these, on IP addresses and on `localhost`.

web.https.certificate.cert.doc: A PEM file with the certificate chain, used with `key`.

web.https.certificate.key.doc: A PEM file with the private key of `cert`.

web.https.certificate.password.doc: The password of the PKCS#12 file.

web.https.certificate.pfx.doc: A PKCS#12 file with the certificate and its key, used when `cert` is not set.

web.https.force.doc: Redirects HTTP requests to HTTPS and sends HSTS.

web.https.ip_address.doc: The addresses to listen on, comma-separated; every address when not set.

web.ip_address.doc: The addresses to listen on, comma-separated; every address, IPv6 and IPv4, when not set.

web.live.max_streams_per_principal.doc: How many event streams one principal may hold open.

web.logging.doc: Logs one line per HTTP request.

web.port.doc: The HTTP port; `0` takes a free port the system picks, which the log names.

web.socket.doc: Also listens on a unix domain socket at this absolute path.

web.trusted_proxies.doc: Reverse proxies, as networks, whose `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `X-Forwarded-Host` headers are believed.

web.url_base.doc: The path the daemon is served under behind a reverse proxy, such as `/reseek`.
